describes.instructions: `wish` was typed into the search of a TV app that holds live channels, movies and series. Does `wish` describe what kind of movie or series the person wants to watch (a mood, theme, sub-genre, subject, setting or occasion), rather than naming one specific title, channel, person or sports team?

criteria.true: A description of the kind of thing to watch, in any language: a mood, theme, sub-genre, subject or occasion, e.g. a type of film, a feeling, a topic, an evening plan
criteria.false: The name of one specific movie, series, channel, actor, team or event, or a fragment of such a name

kind.instructions: Does `wish` ask for movies, for series, or does it leave that open?

criteria.movie: Asks for a movie or film (words like movie, film, Film, Streifen)
criteria.series: Asks for a series or show (words like series, show, Serie, Staffel)
criteria.either: Does not say whether it should be a movie or a series

genre.instructions: Is {genre} the main genre of what `wish` asks for, so that browsing {genre} titles is a good start?

criteria.true: The wish names this genre or a sub-genre of it, or clearly implies it
criteria.false: The genre is unrelated, only loosely possible, or just one of many that could fit

keyword.instructions: Does the TMDB keyword `keywords[{index}]` name the theme, subject or sub-genre that `wish` is looking for?

criteria.true: Titles tagged with this keyword are what the wish describes
criteria.false: The keyword only shares a word with the wish, or is about something else

fit.instructions: Is `titles[{index}]` the kind of movie or series that `wish` asks for?

criteria.true: Its genres and story clearly match the mood, theme or sub-genre in the wish
criteria.false: It only shares a broad genre with the wish, or does not match it
